I have been farming this land since I was a young boy, and maize is what feeds my family. The government gives us fertilizer coupons, so I will put that chemical fertilizer and hybrid seed on this main plot because it is our most important field. I am too old now to dig and carry like I used to, so my children and grandchildren will work here, and we will need to hire some young men from the village when it is time to plant and harvest.
